title: Save a playable asset
content_data:
Use this endpoint to save a playable asset. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/playable/save/|/v1.3/playable/save/| |Request parameter data type|`advertiser_id`: number
`playable_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string
`playable_id`: string| |Response parameter data type|`playable_id`: number|`playable_id`: string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/playable/save/ **Method** POST **Header** ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | Access-Token {Required} | string | Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| | Content-Type {Required} | string | Request Message Type
Allowable value: `application/json` | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | advertiser_id {required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | playable_id {required} | string | Playable asset ID. | | playable_name {required} | string | Playable asset name. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/playable/save/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "playable_id": "{{playable_id}}", "playable_name": "{{playable_name}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|Return message. For details, see [Appendix-Return information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | request_id | string | The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| playable_id | string | Playable asset ID. | #| playable_url | string | Playable URL. | #| playable_name | string | Playable asset name. | #| playable_orientation | string | Playable asset orientation.

Enum values:
  • `BOTH`: vertical or horizontal.
  • `LANDSCAPE`: horizontal.
  • `PORTRAIT`: vertical.
| #| status | string | Playable asset status.

Enum values:`AUDIT_FAIL`,`AUDIT_SUCCESS`, `VALIDATE_FAIL`, `VALIDATE_SUCCESS`, `VALIDATING`. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "playable_id": "{{playable_id}}", "playable_name": "{{playable_name}}", "playable_orientation": "BOTH", "playable_url": "{{playable_url}}", "status": "VALIDATE_SUCCESS" } } (/code); ```
